# ZAID.WORLD

> Interactive portfolio of Zaid — a first-year B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at KL University (Vijayawada, India) building web products, 3D experiments and the early shape of an AI startup.

Everything on the site is labelled honestly: projects are marked as concept, in progress or built. Nothing is claimed that is not true today.

## Sections
- Home: introduction
- About: who Zaid is and how he works
- Work: Nexus AI (concept), Neural Desk (concept), FoodFusion (in progress), Zaid Luxuries (concept)
- Experiments: small games, algorithm flowcharts and ideas in the lab
- Tech stack: tools he is building with, learning and exploring
- Journey: timeline from first year onward
- Beyond: chess, table tennis, films, books and paradoxes
- Contact: GitHub and LinkedIn (handle: zaidycodes)
